metadata.description: Vendored Corepass Code plugins, installable with `harness marketplace add`

plugins.name: sfranalytics
plugins.description: SFR property data + AI — screen deals, research buyers, analyze markets in seconds.

plugins.name: wavus
plugins.description: Wavus integration — search for customers, companies, investors, and key decision-makers in one place, with natural-language prospect search, fit scoring, and data enrichment, via the remote Wavus MCP server.

plugins.name: kanban
plugins.description: The Corepass Work board — read and write cards, move them between columns, assign them to teammates, and file work under an epic, on the team board or your own private one.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Search, read, draft, and manage email.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub integration — manage repositories, issues, pull requests, and workflows through natural language, via the remote GitHub MCP server.

plugins.name: zoom-plugin
plugins.description: Plan, build and debug Zoom integrations across REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, bots and MCP, with Zoom's MCP servers for meetings, recordings, Docs, Chat, Tasks, Revenue Accelerator and Whiteboard.

plugins.name: slack
plugins.description: Slack integration for searching messages, sending communications, managing canvases, and more

plugins.name: carta
plugins.description: Carta integration — cap tables, fund and investor data, and the Carta CRM, via the remote Carta MCP server. Pairs with the Carta Cap Table, Carta Investors and Carta CRM skill plugins.

plugins.name: noibu
plugins.description: Noibu ecommerce analytics — session analytics, error diagnosis, checkout analysis, product performance and accessibility audits, via the remote Noibu MCP server.

plugins.name: nightvision
plugins.description: NightVision DAST and API discovery — scan local, private and staging apps, extract OpenAPI specs from source, triage findings and wire scans into CI, through NightVision's local MCP server and the NightVision CLI.
